title: Three months of work. Now seven minutes.

source.speaker: Sam Altman
source.comment: passages are in SOURCE time; everything outside them is dropped
source.comment2: aroll is cropped from the 3840x2160 source to 1620x2160 around the subject, NOT downscaled to 1080p first. A 9:16 crop from 1080p is only 607px wide and has to be upscaled 1.78x, which is visibly soft. From 2160p it is 1215px and downscales. Crop x=1571 puts the subject at 0.5 of the cropped frame.
source.comment3: 0.44 rather than 0.5: he faces screen-left, so shifting the window left leaves looking room in the direction he is facing. Dead-centring a profile shot crowds the face against the edge it is looking at.

rights.speaker: Sam Altman

comment3: Eleven distinct clips so no asset appears twice in the video. Repeats read as a shortage of material even when the placement is right.
